summary: Brainsway Ltd. furnished a routine Form 6-K containing its condensed consolidated unaudited interim financial statements and operating and financial review for the six months ended June 30, 2026, incorporated by reference into existing Form S-8 and F-3 registration statements. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanic is disclosed; exhibits cover only financial statements, MD&A, and XBRL tagging. As an ordinary foreign-private-issuer periodic report, it presents no special-situation event. Watch for subsequent 6-K disclosures on material corporate actions rather than this earnings filing.
